en.name: Parmesan, block
en.summary: Block parmesan is a very hard, long-aged grating cheese with so little moisture that it keeps better than almost any other cheese. Unopened it lasts about 6 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, 3–4 weeks once opened, and about 6 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: Parmesan is dry and salty enough to sit on a table through a long meal without coming to harm, but it is not a pantry cheese. At room temperature the fat gradually sweats out and the cut face hardens into an inedible crust, and the two-hour rule still applies as a habit (one hour above 32 °C / 90 °F). Grate what you need and put the block back.
en.fridge: Store parmesan at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in the main body of the fridge. Vacuum-sealed it keeps about 6 months from purchase; once opened, 3–4 weeks. Wrap the cut wedge in waxed or greaseproof paper — better still, lightly damp paper — and then in foil or a lidded box. A dry wedge left naked in the fridge turns to a rock in a week; one smothered in cling film sweats and moulds. Both problems have the same answer: paper first, then a loose outer layer.
en.freezer: Parmesan freezes for about 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Because it is already dry and crumbly, it suffers less from freezing than a softer cheese does — grated parmesan in particular comes out of the freezer almost unchanged and can be used without thawing. Freeze it grated in a sealed bag, or in small wedges wrapped airtight.
en.thawing: Thaw a wedge overnight in the fridge in its wrapping and use it within a week or so. Grated parmesan needs no thawing at all — take what you need straight from the bag and return the rest to the freezer immediately.
spoilage: Fuzzy blue, green, black or pink mould on the cut face
A sharp ammonia smell instead of the usual nutty, savoury one
A damp, slimy surface, usually from being wrapped in plastic
A rancid or bitter taste, which points to fat that has oxidised
tips: Buy a wedge and grate it yourself; pre-grated parmesan stales fast and often contains anti-caking agents.
Keep the rinds in a bag in the freezer and simmer them in soups and sauces.
Wrap in slightly damp greaseproof paper, then foil, to stop the face drying out.
Grate the last dry end straight into a freezer bag rather than throwing it away.

faq.q: How long does block parmesan last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 6 months from purchase while vacuum-sealed, and 3–4 weeks once opened, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
Yes, for about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F). It handles freezing better than softer cheeses, and grated parmesan can be used straight from frozen.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off parmesan?
faq.a: Yes. It is a hard cheese, so cut at least 2.5 cm (1 inch) around and below the mould, avoid touching the mould with the knife, and re-wrap the rest in fresh paper.

faq.q: Can you eat the parmesan rind?
faq.a: It is not pleasant to eat as it is, but it is perfectly edible. Drop it into a soup, stock or tomato sauce as it simmers and remove it before serving.

zh.name: 帕瑪森起司（塊）
zh.summary: 塊狀帕瑪森是長期熟成的超硬質刨絲用起司，含水量極低，耐放程度幾乎是所有起司之最。4°C 以下冷藏，未開封從購買日起約 6 個月，開封後 3～4 週，冷凍約 6 個月。
zh.pantry: 帕瑪森夠乾、夠鹹，整頓飯放在餐桌上也不會出問題，但它不是能常溫保存的起司。室溫下油脂會慢慢滲出，切面會硬成一層吃不動的殼；兩小時原則仍應當成習慣（氣溫超過 32°C 時只有一小時）。刨完需要的量就把整塊收回去。
zh.fridge: 冷藏維持 4°C 以下，放在冰箱主室。真空包裝未開封從購買日起約 6 個月；開封後 3～4 週。切開的那塊請先用蠟紙或烘焙紙包起來——稍微沾濕的紙更好——外面再包鋁箔或放進有蓋盒子。乾放在冰箱裡不包的話，一週就硬得像石頭；用保鮮膜緊緊裹住則會悶出水發霉。兩個問題的解法是同一個：先包紙，外層再鬆鬆包一層。
zh.freezer: 帕瑪森在 −18°C 冷凍，從購買日起約可放 6 個月。因為它本來就乾、本來就碎，冷凍造成的損傷比軟質起司小得多——尤其刨好的帕瑪森，從冷凍庫拿出來幾乎沒有變化，可以不解凍直接使用。建議刨絲後裝密封袋，或切成小塊密封包好再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 整塊請連著包裝放冷藏室退冰一晚，並在約一週內用完。刨絲的完全不需要解凍，要多少拿多少，其餘立刻放回冷凍庫。
spoilage: 切面長出藍色、綠色、黑色或粉紅色的毛狀黴
有刺鼻的阿摩尼亞味，而不是原本的堅果鹹香
表面潮濕黏滑，通常是被保鮮膜密封造成的
吃起來有油耗味或苦味，代表油脂已經氧化
tips: 買整塊自己刨；預刨的帕瑪森走味快，而且多半添加了防結塊劑。
外皮收在冷凍袋裡，煮湯或熬醬時丟一塊進去提味。
用微濕的烘焙紙包起來再包鋁箔，可以避免切面乾裂。
最後乾掉的一小截直接刨進冷凍袋，不要丟。

faq.q: 帕瑪森起司放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，真空未開封從購買日起約 6 個月，開封後 3～4 週。
可以，放 −18°C 約 6 個月。它比軟質起司耐凍，刨好的甚至可以不解凍直接使用。

faq.q: 帕瑪森發霉可以切掉嗎？
faq.a: 可以。它屬於硬質起司，請在霉點周圍與底下各切除至少 2.5 公分，刀子避免碰到霉，再用乾淨的紙重新包好。

faq.q: 帕瑪森的外皮可以吃嗎？
faq.a: 直接啃不好吃，但完全可以食用。熬湯、煮高湯或煮番茄醬時丟一塊進去，上桌前撈出來即可。
